title: Pushed Up During Tummy Time
desc: During tummy time, you planted those little arms down and pushed your chest right up off the mat, holding yourself there with the most determined look on your face. You were already trying to see more of the world, and we loved you for it.
story: Tummy time had not always been your favorite. There were plenty of sessions that ended in protest, your face pressed into the mat, making your feelings very clear. But this time was different. You were placed down and instead of fussing, you went quiet in that focused way that meant something was happening. Slowly, those tiny forearms pressed into the mat, your shoulders tensed, and up came your chest, just enough to lift your chin and look straight ahead. Your eyes were wide, almost surprised at your own strength, like you had not quite expected it to work. We watched from just a few centimeters away, completely silent, not wanting to distract you from this very serious business you were conducting. You held it for a few seconds before gently coming back down, and then you looked up at us as if to ask whether we had seen that. We had. We absolutely had.
